data.one_liner: Android Flutter plugin for Infobip Huawei Mobile Messaging, HMS Push, Inbox, Chat, and RTC.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interface to the Infobip Huawei Mobile Messaging SDK for Flutter apps running on Huawei devices. It enables HMS push notifications, Mobile Inbox, native and embedded Live Chat, and outgoing RTC audio/video calls.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app targeting Huawei devices and require Infobip push notifications.
You need to integrate Infobip Live Chat, Mobile Inbox, or RTC calling features via HMS.
avoid_when: You are developing for iOS, web, desktop, or standard Google/FCM environments instead of Huawei/HMS.
You need reliable background incoming RTC calls or official WebRTC UI features (which are unsupported).
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Infobip features on HMS including Push, Inbox, Chat, and RTC calls.
Supports modern Infobip SDK versions (9.4.0 Core, 2.5.28 RTC Core).
weaknesses: Restricted strictly to Android/HMS platforms; unsupported on iOS, web, or desktop.
Background/terminated incoming RTC and HMS RTC push are unsupported.
Requires complex native setup (AppGallery Connect, SHA-256 signing fingerprints, specific Gradle/AGP configurations).
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring AppGallery Connect, placing agconnect-services.json, setting up SHA-256 signing fingerprints, adjusting build.gradle / gradle.properties for AGP compatibility, and configuring an Infobip account profile.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need cross-platform push notifications (including FCM and HMS) rather than an Infobip-specific Huawei backend.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your target devices use Google Mobile Services (GMS) instead of Huawei Mobile Services.
